title: Check Signal Attributes
text: 当输入信号与选定属性完全匹配或不完全匹配时出错，输入 1 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；按 {Dimensions} 指定维度；{Error when input} 指定当输入满足以下条件时生成错误 Does not match attributes、{Complexity} 指定复数性 Ignore、{Dimensionality} 指定维度检查 Ignore、{Data type} 指定数据类型检查、{General data type}、{Specific floating-point}、{Specific fixed-point}、{Specific integer}、{Sample time}，按实例取值。

ports.name: Input
ports.summary: 输入信号 scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

ports.name: Output
ports.summary: 输出信号 scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

params.name: Error when input
params.values: 当输入满足以下条件时生成错误 Does not match attributes exactly (default) | Matches attributes exactly

params.name: Complexity
params.values: 指定复数性 Ignore (default) | Real | Complex

params.name: Dimensionality
params.values: 维度检查 Ignore (default) | Is... | Is not...

params.name: Dimensions
params.values: 指定维度 1-D (default) | 2-D | Scalar (1-D or 2-D) | Vector (1-D or 2-D) | Vector (1-D or 2-D) or scalar | Row vector (2-D) | Row vector (2-D) or scalar | Column vector (2-D) | Column vector (2-D) or scalar | Full matrix (2-D) | Square matrix (2-D)

params.name: Data type
params.values: 数据类型检查 Ignore (default) | Is... | Is not...

params.name: General data type
params.values: General data type 检查 Boolean (default) | Enumerated | Floating-point | Floating-point or boolean | Fixed-point | Integer

params.name: Specific floating-point
params.values: Specific floating-point 检查 Any floating-point (default) | Double precision | Single precision

params.name: Specific fixed-point
params.values: Specific fixed-point 检查 Any fixed-point (default) | Signed fixed-point | Unsigned fixed-point

params.name: Specific integer
params.values: Specific integer 检查 Any integer (default) | Signed integer | Unsigned integer | int8 | int16 | int32 | uint8 | uint16 | uint32

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time 检查 Ignore (default) | Discrete | Continuous
